svg.title: Secret Tunnel — animated cloud-to-computer connection
svg.desc: Original cloud and laptop artwork with teal rounded lights flowing down the pipe, from the cloud into the computer. Transparent background. Original PNG retained unchanged; only the narrow illuminated pipe lane is rebuilt for animation.
